request: Add `_get_channel_for_user` and `_get_rw_channel_for_user` helpers to hc/front/views.py: load channel by code for owner/member/superuser, reject read-only members on write.

summary.result_text:
I added `_get_channel_for_user` and `_get_rw_channel_for_user` to `hc/front/views.py`, right after `_get_rw_project_for_user`. I haven't run the test suite. `check_code` found no deviations from the reviewed pattern.

- **`_get_channel_for_user(request, code)`**: it loads the channel by code and returns `(channel, rw)`. Superusers and the project owner get `rw=True`. Other users must be a project member, or the view returns 404. Members get `rw` from `membership.is_rw`.
- **`_get_rw_channel_for_user(request, code)`**: it calls the first helper and raises `PermissionDenied` if `rw` is false, so read-only members can't write.

I used the catalog pattern `access.channel_for_user@v1` and kept its `# pcat:` marker above both functions. I also added a one-line docstring to the first helper. The imports it needs were already in the file.

Line 1293 of `views.py` already calls `_get_channel_for_user`, so it now resolves.
